basis: Premature fusion of cranial sutures defines a skull disorder; neurologic injury is not universal across this umbrella.
Glycogen storage disease defined by progressive neurologic dysfunction and neurogenic bladder (80-99%); skin ulcers are secondary complications.
Adenoma arising in the anterior pituitary gland; staining characteristics do not indicate blood-cell disease.
Thoracic skeletal ciliopathy; nephronophthisis/CKD and hepatic fibrosis occur in substantial fractions (>30%) of reported IFT172 cases; other organ frequencies are uncertain.
Antibody-mediated hypersensitivity/autoimmune disease umbrella; no single target organ applies across the group.
Psychiatric dissociative disorder without defined structural neurologic disease or another covered organ disorder.
Inflammation of gastrointestinal mucosa; infection or autoimmune causation is not intrinsic to the umbrella.
Coxsackievirus infection umbrella; myocarditis, meningitis and other organ-specific manifestations do not affect most patients across the group.
Endemic pemphigus foliaceus causes autoimmune superficial skin blistering; mucosal disease is generally absent.
Hypertrophy of pyloric smooth muscle obstructs the gastric outlet; dehydration and electrolyte changes are secondary effects.
Craniofacial skeletal, eyelid/eye and oral cleft malformations define the syndrome; encephalocele and olfactory tract hypoplasia occur in 30-79%.
Hereditary prostate malignancy originates in a reproductive organ outside the axes; urinary invasion or metastasis is not intrinsic.
Inherited follicular keratinization and scarring alopecia disorder with polyamine-metabolism ancestry; corneal dystrophy occurs in only 5-29%.
Familial narrowing of the lumbar spinal canal; persistent nerve injury is not established as a common defining feature.
Inherited orofacial cleft affects oral structures and the facial skeleton.
Fetal akinesia deformation syndrome with defining callosal and forebrain malformations; additional functional organ injury is insufficiently documented.
Developmental delay, skeletal hypoplasia and obesity define the syndrome; hearing impairment 1/2 (50%); ptosis 2/2 omitted at cap; neonatal hypoglycemia is transient.
Spastic paraplegia and dementia define neurologic disease; optic atrophy with visual field loss defines ocular involvement.
Hereditary demyelinating neuropathy, intellectual disability and congenital deafness define the syndrome; muscle wasting reflects denervation.
Inherited ichthyotic skin disorder; associated syndromes do not establish additional organ involvement for this concept.
Distal joint contractures define the disease: camptodactyly 12/12 and restricted forearm rotation 7/11.
Developmental impairment, congenital heart defects and generalized hypertrichosis (10/10) define the syndrome; scoliosis occurs in 3/10 (30%).
Fatty-acid oxidation defect; hepatic dysfunction and rhabdomyolysis characterize the reported index case (1/1); population frequencies remain uncertain.
Pulmonary arterial vascular disease with elevated resistance and right-heart strain; pulmonary parenchymal damage is not defining.
Autoimmune paraneoplastic retinal dysfunction; the associated extraocular malignancy is a separate disease.
